notes.title: 🗺️ Final Update for Rooms of Realities is now available 🌊
notes.content:
Attention, Adventurers: it's time for the finishing touches in Rooms of Realities

Some history:

🔎Do you remember how it all started? First, we prepared a demo of Rooms of Realities, and on June 13, 2023, we launched the Early Access of the game. In that version, the entire "In the Shadows of the Pyramid" scenario was available. We were also ready for your feedback and to introduce further corrections and stories into the game.

Then, following the roadmap, we introduced further improvements to the game, as well as a new scenario, "The Forsaken Asylum" (in July), and the final set of escape rooms collected in "Nemo's Mysterious Formula" scenario (in August). This progression culminated in the release of the full version of the game on November 17, 2023, which included, among other features, Victory Rooms that allow you to pose for fancy, cool photos after completing the scenarios.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/fe16bce796fe078e026781ba43dae04da817fe3a.jpg

What now:

🔎Almost half a year has passed since the release of the full version of Rooms of Realities, and this project continues to bring us immense joy. We are pleased to announce another update aimed at enhancing the aspect of the game you've most frequently inquired about - extending the duration of the third act in the "The Forsaken Asylum" scenario.

The Final Update also enhances interactions with certain items, especially levers, and optimizes game physics, particularly during online play with friends.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/2eff0a10ac5ff244c8a9660c8d343a888af4cd9a.jpg

What’s next?

🔎We know that many of you enjoyed our approach to virtual Escape Rooms and that some of you would like to see more Rooms of Realities. Currently, we are not yet ready to reveal our future plans, but stay tuned to see what else we come up with in the future!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1917810/Rooms_of_Realities/

~ Bluekey & Gamedust Team

notes.title: ☕️How we prepared Posters for Rooms of Realities
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40000399/e9b756f20c3896ea2448f8f751b2698ed629cbb9.jpg
Today, we will tell you about how we prepared the posters that accompany you inside the game.

As you can easily see, Rooms of Realities is a game consisting of rooms placed in three environments: Asylum, Egypt, and a mysterious submarine.

In our lore, however, players meet in their friend's basement (which serves as a lobby) to choose a cassette from which they will play a movie that takes them on a joint adventure. Since we have chosen this method of presenting transportation to fantastic worlds, we have prepared special posters for each of them, which also appear on the wall as the game progresses.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/00116b1c242a40983975cf73b6fca0b3d9a35300.jpg

✴️We start, of course, with the "In the Shadow of the Pyramids" scenario, inspired by classic adventure cinema. The characters on the poster are clearly working together to find a solution to a mystery, whether through books or observation:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/909a2c72b96131f978ceb5c981dc7cc6ee150e26.jpg

✒️The next poster was created for "The Forsaken Asylum" scenario. We wanted to show that despite the spooky atmosphere of the place we take the players to, the adventure remains light and humorous:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/b25a1f99703b107d11b8536fbdf05e4d6cd58da4.jpg

⚓️The poster for the "Nemo's Mysterious Formula" scenario focuses on the characters taking over the reins. Since this is the third adventure for them (and for the players), we wanted to show not only the new environment but also the confidence radiating from the adventurers:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42289845/b5694aa550e850942a2defe46af80abb629cc9f0.jpg

📞Let us know which poster you liked the most and why! We are moving forward and would like to hear your opinion.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1917810/Rooms_of_Realities/

Bluekey & Gamedust Team

notes.title: Let's start the adventure - Rooms of Realities version 1.0 awaits!
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40000399/9122019179d3c6bb2d8080005dd48005982db8a9.png
Hello, all Adventurers and Puzzle Solvers,

After five months of intense work, effort and collecting feedback, Rooms of Realities is finally available in version 1.0! Welcome to our collection of Escape Rooms.

[previewyoutube=MfPxiJTQ9g8;full][/previewyoutube]

Check them out by playing the way you like - in single-player mode or in cooperation with up to four people. The rooms are prepared in such a way that both versions will offer just as fun experience. Check out what Rooms of Realities consists of now!

Three unique scenarios, each consisting of three chapters

🔥 In the Shadow of the Pyramids, the scenario begins by leading us to the tent where researchers study ancient artifacts, and then it guides us into the heart of the pyramid. What mysteries lie concealed within its depths, and how can we illuminate chambers that have remained shrouded in darkness for centuries?

🔥 Embark on the Forsaken Asylum scenario, where your primary instinct is to escape the eerie surroundings. Luckily, a whimsical specter is on hand to offer guidance. We've crafted a humorous homage to the classic horror films, ensuring an atmosphere that is spooky but intentionally devoid of fear and tension.

While gathering feedback from our community, we found out that you need new challenges and that you like swinging around space stations so much - Following our recent "Comfort Zone" Update aimed at enhancing your gaming experience, we're here with some cosmic news – it's time for the "Pick Your Challenge Update."

🌟 Easy: In this setting, the game is exceptionally forgiving, and your adversaries won't drain your energy as swiftly.
🌟 Normal: The current difficulty level you're familiar with.
🌟 Hard: Brace yourself for an intense cosmic ride! In this mode, the slightest misstep could mean instant peril. It's a realm exclusively for the most skilled astronauts among you!

We've also introduced something even more captivating: a total of nine options to fine-tune the game's difficulty, allowing everyone to set their Yupitergrad 2 experience to their liking.

Here are the settings you can now find in the game options menu:

💥 Enemies bullets speed - Adjust the rate of fire for enemy projectiles.
💥 Enemies damage - Customize the lethality of enemy bullets.
💥 Enemies health - Set the health levels for opponents.
💥 Enemies movement speed - Modify the agility and pace of enemy movements.
💥 Enemies shield - Define the resilience of enemy shields.
💥 Enemies shield orb spawn probability - Control the likelihood of shield orbs spawning.
💥 Minigun overheat time - Fine-tune the cooling time for your minigun.
💥 Traps damage - Determine the severity of trap effects.
💥 Closed atmospheric levels - Enhance maneuverability within enclosed atmospheric environments.

Yupitergrad 2 was originally designed with a singular difficulty level in mind, making the task of adapting more difficulty levels, and variables a cosmic puzzle in itself. Nevertheless, we've tuned various gameplay elements to ensure that everyone, from seasoned space acrobats to professional adventurers, can relish the Yupitergrad 2 experience.

notes.title: 🎬A BRAND NEW YUPITERGRAD 2 TRAILER is here! Meet AIsha!🎬
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404139/f8e97f0750559300d37a1810cdd627627fc1583c.jpg

A new trailer is here, together with some new exciting info about the game!


As we get closer to the release of Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station, we're gearing up to give you a more in-depth look at what kind of game we're preparing. And there is not a better way to do this than showing you our new trailer

Swinging through the corridors, solving environmental puzzles, opening new passages, and fighting rebellious robots are just some of the exciting elements of Yupitergrad 2 you will see in the trailer below. All neatly commented by our wonderful narrator. 

We cannot also forget about AIsha - our loyal virtual companion. With her help, the journey through the dangerous station will be much more interesting and comfortable:

[previewyoutube=pVHP0t5ACgo;full][/previewyoutube]

🎖️About the game
Yupitergrad 2 is an action adventure game in which you move around an abandoned space station using suction cups attached to ropes. Wait, but that’s just the beginning! You’ll also have jets (nozzles) to maneuver in the air, and a set of powerful weapons to eliminate cheesy robotic opponents.

The game consists of everything a good VR adventure should have: environmental puzzles, hostile enemies, exciting combat system, lots of gadgets and some easter eggs with some strong vibes of metroidvania games.

Not only that, the light and humorous tone of the game will definitely keep you engaged through the whole experience. 

⭐What's new in Yupitergrad 2?

It's full of new ideas - we built this game according to the principle of "more & better".

First of all, we focused on the open structure of the space base, in which you should look for ways to open further passages. We will encounter rebellious machines to fight and shoot at with our new weapons. Our hero will use various helpful gadgets to maneouvre the game world, and his companion AIsha will finally appear on the screen!

All this together creates a new, more adventurous atmosphere and the feeling of actually taking part in a great space adventure in VR.

🐸Do I need to know Yupitergrad 1 to enjoy the sequel?

Yupitergrad 2 very gently refers to the first part, being a completely new story. We took an approach similar to games like Mario or Zelda - where each part is a separate entity, but takes some basics and expectations from its predecessor.

⚡️Game access and release
The release is now set for the first half of 2023. The game will be available on Pico Neo headsets, and a little later on Meta Quest 2. Further platforms, including Steam and HTC Vive XR Elite, will have release dates after the release on Quest 2.
 
Also, we'll soon be sending the trial version to the press and influencers, so you can check out their impressions online before the full release so stay tuned!

notes.title: 👀 Getting closer!~
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40000399/a5ed40420fb326778a11ec85ddd73ebb7dabc99a.gif
Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station is the next step in the development of VR games and our studio. We want to prove with this title that free movement in 3D, dynamic combat, and unlocking passages can work well in virtual reality. In a few months, we will offer you our vision of Metroidvania, which you can immerse yourself in completely. All that will happen in a vast, and infinite cosmos. Far, far away.

This approach - to create a more ambitious, more complex, and simply bigger game is also connected with the fact that some of its elements are rebuilt and redesigned many times. 
Before we can show you another fragment of Yupitergrad 2 in the form of a video (as in the first trailer), we want to invite you for a small walk through the concept art on the basis of which we develop our title:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404139/b0aaadecf6778c49ed009113a073a6bef9fecf15.png

Yes, Yupitergrad 2 also has huge obstacles and windmills. We arrange them so that they make an additional impression with their scale.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404139/6d544a48362079ea2f4e83bdc977d0304a349ea6.png

Is this a shooting range? I think so! Now that you have a gun, you should also have a place to exercise freely.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404139/0ee3ab4387c80acac9079726d058ed38bc4e1c31.png

The new space station will use known puzzles in new, fresh colors. Such obstacles will be a great test of your skills and an opportunity to really feel the dynamics of the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404139/8d53ff4c68bcaa6150bfdd72570b74d22d993ce4.png

This buddy is not an ordinary robot - he perfectly patrols the corridors and very often gets in our way. Pay attention to its turret, it is very similar to the one you will be fighting with!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404139/070f9a0b34affe558e06db7da02def819465964e.png

Docks are a place without which a space station does not exist. We hope you will see something fresh in our vision when you have the opportunity to fly over them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404139/4c98eced60bb9b6e56b05e0df12fddfd677d8484.png

One of the most important aspects of Yupitergrad and Yupitergrad 2 is scale. Since the game is based almost entirely on moving on ropes with suction cups, each location must offer enough space. It is not easy in VR, especially with adequate information about where the player is and where to go next. Above you can see how we design specific places and traps based on this attitude - always bearing in mind how much they must be larger than the hero's character.

notes.title: Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station is coming to Steam!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/d01747c3f4fe7d148ffac1282d8ba611e094d23e.jpg

During the development of Yupitergrad we wanted to bring a real breakthrough to the world of Virtual Reality.

It was a challenge on which we focused all our strengths and resources and worked for months without rest. We finished the game, but it didn't quite feel like our entire, huge vision managed to find its way into (virtual) reality.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/f3d326a818eb054b25029ac70e3c8f6a2de8850a.gif

The changes we dreamed about for a long time, made us return to the drawing board, and we realized that we cannot limit ourselves to creating only new additions to something that already exists.
Because our dreams outgrew their container.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404139/f36b3a6131e29f1c695daebf65eec23a6ecce1f8.gif

Here’s why, instead of reshaping the original, we began working on Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station, a true sequel that will allow us to boldly stand next to such important titles for Virtual Reality as Superhot, HL: Alyx or Population: One.
We want our new title to prove that Virtual Reality is ready for real action-adventure games.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42404139/29959f02d0d720609dc3e45a84d1d643b33c59e6.gif

So what's changing? First of all, an extensive space base, with its own secrets to discover and robots that, for some reason, decided to attack us. During our journey, we will be accompanied by AIsha, a wonderful artificial intelligence whose voice and abilities will aid us during our exploration and traverse of the mysterious space station.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41272375/efb7281ecd56b07ee44295f76f9ab71e8cd97fd8.gif

We have thrown the features of modern Metroidvania into our workshop and decided to transfer, first time in video games history, them to Virtual Reality. And we can't wait for you to play it!

Therefore, please be with us and wait for Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station. We love sci-fi movies, games that take us to space stations, and books about traveling to the stars - we will do everything to make this passion noticeable also in Yupitergrad 2: The Lost Station.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1969000
Wishlist (& Follow) the game - so the new child of our passion can reach a wider audience!
